Begin _2_mazedbandEnd_Script

short button
short messageOn
short reset
short OnPcEquip

;if ( MenuMode == 1 )
;	Return
;endif


if ( OnPCEquip == 0 )
	set reset to 0
endif

if ( reset == 1 )
	return
endif

if ( OnPCEquip == 1 )
	if ( reset == 0 )
		Set OnPCEquip to 0
		MessageBox "Use the Mazedband to teleport where?" "Vivec" "Mournhold" "Sotha Sil" "Nowhere"
		if ( GetJournalIndex TR_SothaSil == 100 )
			set messageOn to 2
		else
			set messageOn to 1
		endif
	endif
endif

if ( messageOn == 1 )

	set button to GetButtonPressed

	if ( button >= 0 )
		set messageOn to 0
	endif

	;vivec
	if ( button == 0 )
		playsound "conjuration hit"
		Player->PositionCell 12, 219, -501, 0 "Vivec, High Fane"
		set reset to 1		

	;mournhold
	elseif ( button == 1 )
		playsound "conjuration hit"
		Player->PositionCell 0, -478, -645, 0 "Mournhold Temple: High Chapel"
		set reset to 1		

	;sotha sil
	elseif ( button == 2 )
		playsound "conjuration hit"
		Player->PositionCell 3985, 776, 12432, 0 "Sotha Sil, Dome of Sotha Sil"
		set reset to 1
		return

	elseif ( button == 3 )
		set reset to 1
		return

	endif

endif

if ( messageOn == 2 )

	set button to GetButtonPressed

	if ( button >= 0 )
		set messageOn to 0
	endif

	;vivec
	if ( button == 0 )
		MessageBox "You feel a powerful force interrupt the Mazed Band's spell and pull you toward Mournhold."
		playsound "conjuration hit"
		Player->PositionCell 0, -478, -645, 0 "Mournhold Temple: High Chapel"
		set reset to 1		

	;mournhold
	elseif ( button == 1 )
		MessageBox "You feel a powerful force interrupt the Mazed Band's spell and pull you toward Mournhold."
		playsound "conjuration hit"
		Player->PositionCell 0, -478, -645, 0 "Mournhold Temple: High Chapel"
		set reset to 1		

	;sotha sil
	elseif ( button == 2 )
		MessageBox "You feel a powerful force interrupt the Mazed Band's spell and pull you toward Mournhold."
		playsound "conjuration hit"
		Player->PositionCell 0, -478, -645, 0 "Mournhold Temple: High Chapel"
		set reset to 1
		return

	elseif ( button == 3 )
		set reset to 1
		return

	endif

endif


End

Begin _almalightning

short state	
float posiz
float timer				

; -- -- Frost Block Trigger Menumode Block
if ( MenuMode == 1 )
	Return
endif


if ( GetDisabled == 1 )
	if ( state <= 200 )
		set state to ( state + 1 )
		Return
	else
		setdelete 1
		DontSaveObject
		Return
	endif
endif

; -- -- Frost Block Trigger Spell Block
if ( state == 0 )
	set posiz to GetPos, Z
	SetPos, Z, 12475
	ExplodeSpell "_alma_explosion"
	set state to 1
	Return
elseif ( state == 1 )
	set timer to (timer + GetSecondsPassed)
	if(timer > 1)
		set state to 2
		Disable
	endif
	Return
endif

End

begin _imp_boss_spawn

float timer

if(menumode == 0)
if(imp_laserd == 0)
if (imp_stage >= 2)
	set timer to (timer + GetSecondsPassed)
	if(timer >= 20)
		set timer to 0
		PlaySound "SothaFabMachine"
		if(imp_fabcount < 2)
			set imp_fabcount to (imp_fabcount + 1)
			PlaceAtMe "Imperfect2", 1, 1 ,1
		endif
	endif
endif
endif
endif
end

begin _imp_bossmainscript

float timer
short doonce
short doonce2
short doonce3
if(imp_begin == 1)

if(MenuMode == 0)

if(imp_stage == 0)
	set timer to (timer + GetSecondsPassed)
	if(doonce == 0)
		PlaySound "FabBossAlive"
		DisablePlayerControls
		set doonce to 1
		set imp_lasertime to 2
	endif
	if(timer > 8)
		if(doonce2 == 0)
			PlaySound "FabBossRoar"
			PlaceAtMe, "act_Sotha_Music6", 1, 1, 1
			EnablePlayerControls
			set doonce2 to 1
			set imp_stage to 1
		endif
	endif
endif

if(imp_stage == 1)
	set timer to (timer + GetSecondsPassed)
	if (timer > 30)
		MessageBox "Gestalt has placed down devices to assist you."
		PlaySound "FabBossWhir"
		PlaySound "FabBossGyro"
		PlaySound "fabBossLeft"
		set imp_stage to 2
		set imp_lasertime to 15
		set timer to 0
	endif
endif

if(Imp_contained >= 4)
	set imp_stage to 3
		if(doonce3 == 0)
			PlaySound "FabBossWhir"
			PlaySound "FabBossGyro"
			PlaySound "fabBossLeft"
			PlaySound "FabBossRoar"
			set doonce3 to 1
		endif
	set imp_lasertime to 1
endif

if(imp_laserd == 1)
	set imp_stage to 4
	set imp_lasertime to 0
endif
endif
endif

end

begin _imp_destroy

float timer 
short doonce
short doonce2
short doonce3
short doonce4
short doonce5
short doonce6

if (menumode == 0)
if(OnActivate == 1)
	set imp_laserd to 1
	PlaySound "FabBossDead"
	PlaySound "sotha_laser"
endif

if(imp_laserd == 1)
set timer to (timer + GetSecondsPassed)
	if(timer >= 2)
		set imp_fallscene to 1
	endif
	if(timer >= 3)
		if(doonce == 0)
			PlaySound "FabBossDead"
			set doonce to 1
		endif
	endif
	if(timer >= 4)
		set imp_fallscene to 2
		if(doonce2 == 0)
			PlaySound "FabBossDead"
			set doonce2 to 1
		endif
	endif
	if(timer >= 6)
		set imp_fallscene to 3
		if(doonce3 == 0)
			PlaySound "FabBossDead"
			set doonce3 to 1
		endif
	endif
	if(timer >= 8)
		set imp_fallscene to 4
		if(doonce4 == 0)
			PlaySound "FabBossDead"
			set doonce4 to 1
		endif
	endif
	if(timer >= 10)
		set imp_fallscene to 5
		if(doonce5== 0)
			PlaySound "FabBossDead"
			set doonce5 to 1
		endif
	endif
	if(timer >= 12)
		set imp_fallscene to 6
		if(doonce6 == 0)
			PlaySound "FabBossDead"
			set doonce6 to 1
		endif
	endif
if(timer > 15)
	StreamMusic "Victory.mp3"
	Player-> PositionCell, 3353, 4014, -3841, 0, "Sotha Sil, The Imperfect Destroyed"
endif
endif
endif

end

Begin _imp_gunsout

float timer
short doonce 
short ObjectCount
short stuffloaded
short doonce2


if(stuffloaded >= 1)
	if(doonce2 == 0)
		set imp_contained to (imp_contained + 1)
		MessageBox "This contraption's tank is now full"
		PlaySound "FabBossRoar"
		PlaySound "restoration hit"
		set doonce2 to 1
	endif
endif

if(menumode == 0)
If (imp_stage >= 2)
	set timer to (timer + GetSecondsPassed)
	if(timer < 4)
		MoveWorld Z, -5072
	else 
		if(doonce == 0)
			PlaySound "fabBossLeft"
			set doonce to 1
		endif
	endif
endif
endif

if (OnActivate == 1)
if (stuffloaded < 1)
